plan.notes: CATALOG INCONSISTENCY (verified 2026-10-06 via catalog.collin.edu and independent browser fetch): the published AA General Studies sequence lists two 4-SCH 'Life and Physical Sciences course with lab' slots, making the core 44 SCH; with 18 SCH of electives the sequence sums to 62 SCH, but the page states 'Total Credit Hours: 60'. Transcribed exactly as published (62 SCH of slots). The catalog's own footnote 2 acknowledges students may earn more than 42 core hours, with extras applied to degree requirements.
